correctness.rationale: For each n=r+2>=4, every basic map is exactly two-valued; five stated relations are preserved. Any congruence restricts on B either to equality or to universal equivalence, because the family contains extensions of all two-valued B maps. The first case forces 0 or tau; the second rho, sigma or universal. A partition-lattice chain length gives n>=4. Exhaustive standalone direct computation verifies n=4..8, with no extrapolation.

value.rationale: Provides the complete natural carrier-size spectrum for the nondistributive pentagon N5 and thereby, together with published spectral results, completes the small five-element lattice class. The strict contrast with M3 (only carrier 3) is structural and concerns an explicit open spectrum problem, not a routine known table recomputation.
